verdict.rationale: A and B are comparably defensible for a car-free South Lake Union work trip. B is slightly cheaper, closer, and more highly rated, while A includes breakfast and explicitly notes a usable desk, both meaningful for a Tue-Fri onboarding stay. The query does not state how Maya or the approver values included breakfast and workroom certainty relative to rating, modest price savings, and a shorter walk. C is less compelling because B is also cheaper, better rated, and more convenient to the client; D has a less predictable commute and mixed desk feedback.
